title: Looksmaxxing and Face Analysis: A Responsible Guide for Beauty Brands
summary: Understand looksmaxxing and how beauty, grooming, and eyewear brands can use face analysis for personalized recommendations—not appearance ratings.
body_markdown:
### What is looksmaxxing?


Looksmaxxing is an online trend of trying to maximize physical appearance, popular with teens and young men. It spans lower-risk grooming and skincare through to high-risk practices such as bonesmashing, steroid use, and repeated surgery.


### Is face analysis the same as an attractiveness test?


No. Both can use facial landmark detection, but an attractiveness test turns measurements into a score. Face analysis for brands turns them into descriptions and product recommendations.


### How can brands use the looksmaxxing trend without harming customers?


Serve softmaxxing needs such as skincare, grooming, and eyewear; avoid scores and deficit language; seek consent; protect younger users; and leave clinical decisions to qualified practitioners.


### What does AI Face Analyzer measure?


Perfect Corp.’s AI Face Analyzer detects face shape, 70+ features across the eyes, brows, nose, lips, and cheekbones, 11 facial proportions, and personal color signals such as skin tone and undertone.


### Does face analysis give a beauty score?


It does not have to, and we recommend it does not. Results work best as a personalized beauty report: face shape, proportions, and color, each linked to a suitable product or style.
